source: Observed local Chrome run before support-specific collision overrides
action: Select Resolved from the selected ticket status control after loading a 50-ticket page
observed: Playwright option click timed out; its trace repeatedly reported element is outside of the viewport after scrolling into view.
sourceFinding: The shared SelectContent sets avoidCollisions=false. Support dropdowns previously supplied no override.
captureLimit: A second diagnostic run reproduced the click failure but the diagnostic's accessible-role lookup could not find the aria-hidden background trigger, masking the original error. No pre-fix screenshot/bounds are claimed.
repairScope: Enable collision handling only on the four support-panel SelectContent usages; leave shared select.jsx unchanged.
